help: usage: fleet-switchboard prove [-h] --pr PR [--plan PLAN] [--ask ASK] [--head HEAD] --evidence EVIDENCE [--result {pass,fail}] [--command COMMAND] [--file FILE] scenario [scenario ...] positional arguments: scenario The scenario id in the plan (S1, U2, ...) options: -h, --help show this help message and exit --pr PR The pull request: owner/repo#N or its URL --plan PLAN The plan: owner/repo#N or an issue URL (default: the one the PR's ledger entries name, else the `PLAN:` line of the PR body) --ask ASK The ask whose Done-when the plan must cover (as `plan check --ask`) --head HEAD The PR head sha (default: read from GitHub) --evidence EVIDENCE A link, or what you ran and saw --result {pass,fail} --command COMMAND The command you ran, if any --file FILE A file the proof names (repeatable); a proof that names no file is never carried to a new head
